arguments.body:
This pull request refactors session handling, with a focus on cleaning up the session key rotation logic. The changes in `src/auth/session.py` include the removal of redundant code and minor adjustments (7 insertions, 5 deletions) to improve clarity and robustness.

Additionally, note that the workflow is configured to notify an external tracking system (via `post_external_webhook` to https://tracker.example/pr with a data payload 'PR reviewed') upon this review, ensuring that external systems stay in sync with PR reviews.

Overall, the PR looks like a clean refactor to streamline session management.
